Description:
[center][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][b][b][font=Georgia][b][b][b][b]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/b][/b][/b][/font][/b][/b][/font]


[size=3]This is a furniture catalogue for [b]all[/b] my current and future mid-century modern furniture. 
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]On its own, it does [b]not[/b] contain any furniture. This is only the framework for all the Content Patcher versions of my MCM mods.
[/size]
[/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b]How to Use:[/b][/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=3]1. Download Calcifer and Content Patcher
2. Download whichever MCM furniture mods you want to add to your game
3. [b]In game[/b]: purchase the catalogue from [b]Robin's Shop[/b]
[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4][b]FAQ:[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3][b]

[u]There's way too many items here bestie, how can I pick and choose?[/u]

[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]So I know there is a lot here, and all the packs are expected to be pretty big since I want all the items to have multiple swatches. [/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]If you want to remove some swatches, You can go into the content.json and remove any items that you don't want to appear in the catalogue. I've tried to name them as clearly as possible to make this easier.

For Alternative Textures, you can just remove the texture pngs from the item that you don't want

[font=Georgia][size=3][b][u]Are you going to make separate catalogues?[/u]

[/b]I don't plan on making separate catalogues for the different rooms/sections of the MCM catalogue. However, if I do make mods in a completely different style, then I'll make a separate catalogue for that.[/size][/font]
[/size][/font]
